morning.title: Aftermath
morning.description: The apartment is quiet. Four women who once had everything. Now they have each other, and barely that.

messages.content: hey lol. so this is it i guess. sorry it's kinda small. i mean it's fine!! totally fine!! we make it work right??

choices.text: We all need to stick together. That's how we survive.
Did you eat?

messages.content: yeah!! definitely!! we're gonna be fine lol. we just need to like... figure some stuff out. money stuff. boring adult stuff. anyway!!
oh. um. yeah i ate. don't worry about me lol i always eat haha

choices.text: Okay. But if you don't, tell me. I care.

messages.content: so. this is where we're living now. cool.

choices.text: It won't be forever. We can build something from here.
It's not much, but it's ours.

messages.content: ...optimistic. whatever. just don't expect me to pretend everything's fine when it's not.
sure. that's what we tell ourselves, right.

noon.title: Bills
noon.description: Reality crashes in. The phone buzzes with notifications they can't afford to ignore.

messages.content: okay so i checked our accounts!! we have 23,000 won between all of us lol which is like... nothing!! anyway don't worry i'll figure something out!!

choices.text: We need to figure this out together, not just you.
What jobs have you been looking at?

messages.content: oh. um. okay yeah!! together!! got it!! i just... i don't want everyone to worry!! i can handle it!!
um... there's like... delivery work?? and some stuff online?? i can do it!! i can do anything!!
i should tell you all something. about my... situation. with the contract.

choices.text: You can tell us when you're ready. No pressure.
We need to know. It affects all of us.

messages.content: thank you. i... i'll tell you soon. i promise.
right. okay. the contract from starlight entertainment... it was sold. without my consent. to someone who wants me to do 'private events.' i can't work legally anywhere else.

night.title: The Offer
night.description: A familiar face appears. Old wounds reopen.

messages.content: well. what do we have here. my favorite girls, together again. how... touching.

choices.text: What do you want?
Leave. Now.

messages.content: i'm hurt. truly. i came to offer help. but fine. be like that. you know where to find me when you're desperate. i always have... opportunities.
oh sujin. you really think running from me helps? your little 'contract' problem... i could make it disappear. for the right price. think about it.
omg was that YUSEONG?? like from before?? wait why is he HERE?? i thought he got fired??

choices.text: He was involved in what happened to us. Don't trust him.
Did you know what he was doing?

messages.content: i mean... i knew something was wrong. but i didn't know it was HIM. god this is such a mess. we really messed up back then.
what?? no!! i didn't know anything!! i was as messed up as everyone else!! ...wasn't i?

morning.title: Cracks
morning.description: Tensions surface. Old wounds need cleaning.

messages.content: [The group chat is quiet. Too quiet.]

choices.text: Let's talk about what happened. All of it.
We need to focus on moving forward. Not the past.

messages.content: fine. let's talk. i was there when it all fell apart. i watched miho get pushed out. i watched hyunju destroy her body. i watched sujin get sold. and i did... nothing.

choices.text: You were a victim too. You couldn't stop them.

messages.content: ...you don't understand. i COULD have done something. i chose not to. because i was scared. because i thought if i stayed quiet, they'd leave me alone. and they did. for a while.
right!! forward!! positive!! we can do this!! there's always a way!! we just need to try harder right??

choices.text: Hyunju... when did you last sleep?

messages.content: i sleep!! i sleep fine!! i just... i have a lot to do!! if i stop then everything falls apart!! that's how it works!!
okay so um. i found something. this website. it's like... fans pay for messages from ex-idols. it's kinda sketchy but the money is really good and i just... we need it right??

choices.text: No. There's got to be another way.
If you're sure. I don't like it, but I understand.

messages.content: yeah you're right. sorry. i just... i hate feeling useless. i hate not contributing. i just wanted to help.

choices.text: You contribute in other ways. Your value isn't tied to money.

messages.content: okay... i'll do it. it's fine. this is fine. i can do this. i can do anything.
i found a pro bono legal clinic. for entertainment contracts. we could... try. for my situation. if you think it's worth it.

choices.text: Of course it's worth it. Let's go together.

night.title: Truths
night.description: In the dark, secrets fester. Some need light.

messages.content: can we talk? privately? there's something i need to say. to all of you.

choices.text: Of course. We're here.

messages.content: that company that bought my contract. the 'private events.' it's not... it's not dancing. or performances. they wanted me to come to 'private parties.' for 'important clients.' i ran. that's why i have nothing. i chose survival.

choices.text: I'm so sorry. That should never have happened to you.
We need to report this. What they did is illegal.

messages.content: thank you. for not... for not making it weird. or making me feel worse. i just needed someone to know. to witness it. so it's real.
i know. i know we should. but they're powerful. and i'm scared. can we... can we just figure out the legal thing first? before we do anything else?
sujin's story is very... moving. i wonder how it'd sound in the press. 'ex-idol claims abuse, denies contract obligations.' you know how that ends. for her. for all of you.

choices.text: Leave her alone.

messages.content: or what? you have nothing. i have everything. think carefully about whose side you want to be on. i'll be watching.

morning.title: Reckoning
morning.description: A choice must be made. Again.

messages.content: [Everyone is awake. No one slept well.]

choices.text: We need to decide what kind of future we want.

messages.content: i've been thinking. about what we can actually do. i can't keep working the jobs i'm working. my body... it's breaking. i can't admit it but i know.

choices.text: Then we find something else. Together.

messages.content: you all would... help me? even though i can't... even when i can't contribute like before?

choices.text: That's what being a team means. We carry each other.

messages.content: i need to say something too. about before. about all of it.

choices.text: I'm listening.

messages.content: i was scared. of losing what little i had. so i watched everyone suffer and told myself it wasn't my problem. that was wrong. i know that now. i'm sorry it took me this long to say it.

noon.title: Pressure
noon.description: The world doesn't let you breathe.

messages.content: interesting morning. very touching. but here's the thing - pretty words don't pay rent. i have a job. legitimate. well. mostly. and i think sujin would be perfect for it. don't you, sujin?

choices.text: She has a name. And she doesn't work for you.
What exactly are you offering?

messages.content: brave. i like it. for now. but everyone has a price. you'll see.
now we're talking. i have clients. wealthy men. they want entertainment. and sujin here has skills they'd pay for. handsomely. what do you say, sujin? your friends need money. you could provide.

choices.text: Sujin, you don't have to answer that.

messages.content: suit yourselves. but my offer stands. for any of you. times running out. for everyone.
i hate that he's right. about the money. about everything. but we can't... we can't give in right?? we just can't??

choices.text: We won't. There's always another way.

night.title: Fragile
night.description: Something shifts. Something breaks. Something begins.

messages.content: hey. can i tell you something? something i haven't told anyone?

choices.text: Always.

messages.content: when they kicked me out... i stopped eating. not on purpose at first. i was just... numb. and then it became a thing. if i was skinny enough they'd want me back right?? if i was perfect they'd take me back right??

choices.text: You don't have to be perfect. You just have to be here.
We need to get you help. Real help.

messages.content: ...i don't know who i am without trying to be perfect. i've been performing so long i forgot there's a person underneath. is there? is there a person underneath?
i don't know if i can afford help. i don't know if i deserve it. but... maybe i want to try? is that stupid?
i've been watching. all of you. for years. and i finally... i finally feel something. watching you all be honest. it's scary. but maybe that's okay.

choices.text: Feelings are supposed to be scary. That's how you know they're real.
